name: linkedin-api-mcp
description: One plugin: a LinkedIn CLI, library, and MCP server. The server is capability-only by default; opt-in experimental mode lists unofficial own-account operations, and write operations are prepared by the server and executed only after separate operator approval in the CLI.

plugins.name: linkedin
plugins.description: Automate your own LinkedIn account: official OAuth API tools, an MCP server that is capability-only until the experimental option lists operations, writes that are prepared then approved in the separate CLI, and an off-by-default experimental mode.
